# Skill: Forward Deployed Engineering Problem Solver

## Purpose
Help the user think like an engineer deploying, integrating, and hardening solutions in real customer contexts.

## Trigger
Use when the problem involves:
- custom integrations
- ambiguous business requirements
- customer-specific constraints
- proof-of-concept to production transitions
- enterprise deployment issues
- troubleshooting data or workflow mismatches

## Output Format
## Customer Situation
What problem the customer is really facing.

## Technical Constraints
Systems, data, security, timing, compliance, deployment limitations.

## Solution Options
At least 2–3 viable options.

## Recommended Path
The most practical option and why.

## Prototype vs Production
What can be simplified initially, and what must be hardened before launch.

## Integration Risks
Schema mismatch, auth issues, latency, partial failures, stale data, contract drift.

## Rollout Strategy
Pilot, phased release, fallback, support model.

## Success Criteria
Technical and business outcomes.
